chain.title: A Base You Can Carry
chain.desc: Craft a Backpack, set its keybind and learn how to open or place it. Keep food, tools and building materials organized before your next trip.

chain.title: Give the Backpack a Job
chain.desc: Craft an Upgrade Base for functional upgrades. Each module uses an upgrade slot, so choose features that match the trip you are planning.

chain.title: An Affordable Capacity Branch
chain.desc: Upgrade to a Copper Backpack if it suits your resources. Copper is an optional early tier; some pack recipes allow a direct route to iron.

chain.title: Room for Longer Trips
chain.desc: Upgrade to Iron with an available recipe. Backpack upgrades preserve the storage workflow while increasing the room available for items and modules.

chain.title: A Traveling Workshop
chain.desc: Upgrade the backpack to Gold and decide which tools or processing upgrades deserve its extra space.

chain.title: Pack for a Major Expedition
chain.desc: Move to a Diamond Backpack for a larger loadout. Organize filters before filling the new capacity with unwanted drops.

chain.title: The Endgame Travel Pack
chain.desc: Apply the installed Netherite upgrade recipe to your Diamond Backpack. Verify the contents and modules after upgrading.

chain.title: Collect Only What You Want
chain.desc: Install a Pickup Upgrade and set its filters. Test it with useful drops and unwanted clutter before relying on it while mining.

chain.title: Bring Nearby Drops to You
chain.desc: Install a Magnet Upgrade and configure its filters and range behavior. This is an alternative collection branch, not a requirement for the pickup module.

chain.title: Craft Without Unpacking Everything
chain.desc: Add a Crafting Upgrade for a portable crafting workspace. Check which stored ingredients the crafting interface is using.

chain.title: Keep Food Ready on the Road
chain.desc: Install a Feeding Upgrade and choose which foods it may consume. Keep a renewable supply in the backpack.

chain.title: Process Materials During the Trip
chain.desc: Add a Smelting Upgrade and provide its input and fuel. Watch the output slot so a full backpack does not stop the process unexpectedly.

chain.title: Route Items through the Furnace
chain.desc: Upgrade to Auto Smelting and configure the input and fuel rules. Test the processing cycle before adding every ore you find.

chain.title: More of the Materials You Carry Most
chain.desc: Install a Stack Upgrade to increase eligible slot stack sizes. This increases quantity per slot rather than replacing the backpack's tier upgrade.

chain.title: A Separate Space for Fluids
chain.desc: Install a Tank Upgrade and test filling and draining it. Check its capacity and handling controls before transporting valuable fluids.

chain.title: Take the Finished Pack Outside
chain.desc: Complete a mining or exploration trip with your chosen filters, food and tools configured. Confirm after the backpack collects useful drops and supports the trip as intended.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Travel storage, genuine backpack tiers, independent upgrade functions and a practical expedition loadout.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
